typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Provider_ID as string,
		Tax_ID as string,
		NPI as string,
		Provider_Name as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip_Code as string,
		Request_User_ID as string,
		Action as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent
InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent derive(CHANGE_DATE = currentTimestamp(),
		CHANGE_USERID = $userName,
		Active = iif(toInteger(Action) == 3, 0, 1),
		NPI = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(Provider_NPI),' ')),' '),
		Address2 = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(replace(Address2, toString('\"'), toString(''))),' ')),' '),
		Tax_ID = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(Provider_Tax_ID),' ')),' '),
		Address1 = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(replace(Address1, toString('\"'), toString(''))),' ')),' '),
		City = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(replace(City, toString('\"'), toString(''))),' ')),' '),
		Provider_Name = ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(replace(replace(Provider_Name, toString('\"'), toString('')), toString(' – '), toString(' - '))),' ')),' ')) ~> DataCleanup
DataCleanup split(Action == 1,Action == 0, disjoint: true) ~> InsertorUpdate@(Add,Delete,Update)
InsertorUpdate@Add sink(input(
		CITY as string,
		ACTIVE as boolean,
		ZIP_CODE as string,
		NPI as string,
		INSERT_USERID as string,
		STATE as string,
		TAX_ID as string,
		ADDRESS1 as string,
		INSERT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_ID as string,
		PROVIDER_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CITY = City,
		ACTIVE = Active,
		ZIP_CODE = Zip_Code,
		NPI,
		INSERT_USERID = Request_User_ID,
		STATE = State,
		TAX_ID = Tax_ID,
		ADDRESS1 = Address1,
		INSERT_DATE = CHANGE_DATE,
		PROVIDER_ID = Provider_ID,
		PROVIDER_NAME = Provider_Name,
		ADDRESS2 = Address2)) ~> AddNewRecord
InsertorUpdate@Delete sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn()) ~> RemoveRecord
